ingredients.raw: 1 medium-size tomato, peeled, seeded, juiced and chopped
1 ½ to 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil
Salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.item: salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps.text: Place the bulgur in a bowl, pour the boiling water over it and stir in the lemon juice. Cover and set it aside.
Preheat a grill or broiler. Grill or broil the eggplant slices until they are nicely browned, turning them once to brown both sides. Coarsely chop the eggplant and set it aside.
After about 30 minutes, when the bulgur has softened and is cool enough to handle, transfer it to a fine-mesh sieve and press out any excess liquid. Return the bulgur to a bowl.
Fold in the eggplant and all the remaining ingredients. Serve at room temperature.

name: Tacos With Black Beans and Chard
author: Martha Rose Shulman
description: If you are looking to feed a crowd, one way to meet the challenge is to pick up a supply of corn tortillas and make a big pot of beans and some other dishes that are at home in a taco. Buy some salsa, or make your own, and your house will be taco party central. You can make fillings in advance and arrange in bowls or on platters. Then all it takes is warming tortillas in a microwave, oven or steamer, and guests can assemble their own tacos. These beans are great in tacos, but can also be eaten on their own.

ingredients.raw: 1 pound black beans, soaked for 4 to 6 hours or overnight in 2 quarts water
ingredients.preparation: soaked for 4 to 6 hours or overnight in 2 quarts water

ingredients.raw: ½ pound Swiss chard, stemmed, washed and roughly chopped

steps.text: Place the beans and their soaking water in a heavy soup pot or Dutch oven and bring to a boil. Skim away foam and add the onion and half the garlic. Reduce the heat, cover and simmer 1 hour. Add the remaining garlic, salt to taste and half the cilantro, cover and simmer for 45 minutes.
Add the Swiss chard, cover and simmer 10 minutes. The chard should be tender but still have some bright color. Stir in the remaining cilantro, taste and adjust salt.
Warm the tortillas. Top with a generous spoonful of beans with chard, a spoonful of crumbled queso fresco, and salsa if desired.

images.alt: Soft Tacos With Black Beans and Chard

name: Tacos With Roasted Vegetables and Chickpeas in Chipotle Ranchera Salsa
author: Martha Rose Shulman
description: These winter vegetables sweeten with roasting and contrast beautifully with the chipotle-spiked cooked tomato salsa. It’s another easy do-ahead dish that can be reheated when the crowds are hungry.

ingredients.raw: 1 pound butternut squash, peeled and cut in ¾-inch dice
ingredients.preparation: peeled and cut in ¾-inch dice

ingredients.raw: 2 medium turnips (about 10 ounces), peeled and cut in ¾-inch dice
ingredients.preparation: peeled and cut in ¾-inch dice

ingredients.raw: 1 medium fennel bulb, cored and cut in ¾-inch dice
ingredients.preparation: cored and cut in ¾-inch dice

ingredients.raw: 2 tablespoons plus 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil
ingredients.item: plus 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil

ingredients.raw: Salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
ingredients.item: salt and freshly ground pepper to taste

ingredients.raw: 1 red onion, cut in ¾-inch dice
2 ounces queso cotija, queso fresco or feta
1 small onion, cut in half, or .5 medium onion
ingredients.preparation: cut in half, or .5 medium onion

ingredients.raw: 1 or 2 serrano chilies or jalapeños (more to taste), seeded for a milder salsa, roughly chopped
ingredients.item: or 2 serrano chilies or jalapeños (more to taste)
ingredients.preparation: seeded for a milder salsa, roughly chopped

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cover a large sheet pan with foil, and oil the foil. Place all of the vegetables except the onions in a large bowl, season with salt and pepper and toss with the olive oil until all of the vegetables are coated. Spread in an even layer on the prepared pan. Place in the top third of the oven and bake 20 minutes, stirring halfway through. Meanwhile, rinse the onion, drain on paper towels and toss with a teaspoon of olive oil.

Add the onions to the vegetables and toss together. Turn the heat down to 375, move the baking pan to the middle rack and continue to bake until the vegetables are lightly browned on the edges and tender all the way through when pierced with a knife, about 10 to 15 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and add the chickpeas if using.

Make the salsa while the vegetables are roasting. Preheat the broiler. Line a baking sheet with foil and place the onion on it. Broil 5 to 10 minutes, turning once, until charred. Remove from the heat and when cool enough to handle, cut in large dice and place in a blender with the tomatoes, serranos, garlic and chipotle. Purée until smooth.

Heat the canola oil in a heavy saucepan or skillet over medium-high heat until a drop of the puree sizzles immediately on contact. Add the purée, season to taste with salt and cook, stirring often, until the sauce darkens and thickens, leaving a canal when you run the cooking spoon across the bottom of the pan, about 15 minutes. If you want a thinner sauce, thin out with water as needed. Remove from heat. Taste and adjust salt.
Warm the tortillas. Stir some of the salsa (to taste) into the vegetables. Spoon onto the tortillas, sprinkle on the cheese and serve, with more salsa as desired.

name: Tagliarini With Mushrooms, Garlic and Sage
author: Florence Fabricant

ingredients.raw: 6 large garlic cloves, peeled and sliced thin
10 ounces fresh green tagliarini or fettuccine

steps.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.

While the water is coming to a boil, heat two and a half tablespoons of the oil in a large, heavy skillet. Add the mushrooms and saute over high heat until they have wilted and have started to brown. Stir in the garlic and when it begins to color, reduce the heat to low.
Add the pasta to the boiling water, stir in and cook it for two to three minutes. Drain it well, put it in a warm bowl and toss with the remaining half tablespoon of oil.
Increase the heat under the skillet and stir in the sage and pepper flakes, season to taste with salt and pour over pasta. Toss well and serve with Parmesan cheese on side.

name: Tagliatelle With Ham and Fava Beans
author: Moira Hodgson

ingredients.raw: 3 to 4 slices cooked ham, cut in strips
Coarse salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
ingredients.item: coarse salt and freshly ground pepper to taste

ingredients.raw: ¾ cup of grated Parmesan cheese

steps.text: Bring six quarts salted water to boil for the tagliatelle. Steam the fava beans until barely tender. Set aside.
Combine heavy cream, butter and ham in small saucepan and heat. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Add the fava beans and set aside.
Cook the tagliatelle until al dente. Drain and mix with the ham sauce and serve additional Parmesan cheese separately.

ingredients.raw: 1 ¼ cups flour, plus more for rolling
1 large egg yolk, beaten with 2 tablespoons ice water
8 ounces shiitake mushrooms, sliced and stems discarded
6 ounces taleggio, rind removed, sliced thin

steps.text: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Combine flour and salt in food processor. Pulse to combine. Dice butter, and add. Pulse until pebbly. Open lid, and sprinkle with egg yolk mixture. Pulse 10 or 12 times. If dough does not come together, sprinkle on a little more ice water and pulse again. Do not overwork.

Gather dough in a ball, flatten and roll out on floured board. Fit into an 8-or 9-inch tart pan. Prick bottom, line with parchment paper or foil, cover with pastry weights or dry beans and bake 10 minutes. Remove paper and weights. Bake about 10 minutes more, until pastry starts to color. Remove from oven. Reduce heat to 375 degrees.

While pastry bakes, heat oil in a 10-inch skillet. Add half the cumin seeds. When they pop, add mushrooms and shallots, and saute, stirring, until mushrooms start to brown. Season with salt and pepper.
Spread pastry with creme fraiche. Cover with mushrooms, and top with cheese slices. Scatter with remaining cumin. Bake in oven about 20 minutes, until cheese melts. Serve.

ingredients.raw: 2 ounces red onion, about ¼ cup chopped
6 medium Greek, Italian or French black olives

steps.text: Peel and slice the tangerines horizontally. Seed and section. Place in a serving bowl.
Mince the red onion. Pit and coarsely chop the olives. Add to the bowl. Drizzle with oil and mix.

name: Tangy Chicken, Tomato and Couscous Salad
author: Ashley Lonsdale
description: This salad gathers all the great parts of a tagine dinner onto one bowl or plate: fluffy, spiced couscous, sweet, chewy prunes and savory bites of chicken. The “salad” part of the dish is a crown of marinated cherry tomatoes, which add juicy, cooling bites. Heating finely chopped rotisserie chicken in salted water creates an instant stock of sorts to plump the couscous, and extracts and distributes even more savory flavor throughout the dish when time is scarce.

ingredients.raw: 1 ½ pounds cherry tomatoes, halved (4 cups)
Salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.item: salt and freshly ground black pepper

ingredients.raw: ½ cup finely chopped fresh parsley
2 cups cooked chicken, finely chopped (about 8 ounces)
8 sun-dried tomato halves packed in olive oil, roughly chopped, plus ¼ cup olive oil from the jar (or more extra-virgin olive oil as needed)
ingredients.item: sun-dried tomato halves packed in olive oil
ingredients.preparation: roughly chopped, plus ¼ cup olive oil from the jar (or more extra-virgin olive oil as needed)

ingredients.raw: ½ cup roughly chopped dried fruit, such as pitted prunes, raisins, apricots or dates
ingredients.preparation: such as pitted prunes, raisins, apricots or dates

ingredients.raw: ⅛ teaspoon ground ginger 2 cups water
1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice (from ½ lemon)
2 tablespoons capers, plus 2 to 3 teaspoons caper brine

steps.text: In a medium bowl, toss the cherry tomatoes with salt, pepper, parsley and 2 tablespoons of the olive oil reserved from the sundried tomato jar. Set aside.

Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of sun-dried tomato oil in a large saucepan over medium. Add the chicken, sun-dried tomatoes, prunes, cumin and ginger and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring frequently, until sizzling and fragrant. Add the water, bring to a boil over high heat and season the liquid with salt to taste. Stir in the couscous, cover, remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes, until liquid is fully absorbed.
Fluff the couscous-chicken mixture with a fork and stir in the lemon juice, capers and caper brine. Spoon the warm couscous and chicken onto a platter and top with the marinated tomatoes.

name: Tapenade Pasta Salad
author: Clare de Boer
description: This pasta salad is intensely savory and plush with blitzed olives. The green beans and basil let us know it's summer. Unlike many pasta salads, which can be greasy or dry, this one is creamy from the addition of pasta water to the dressing. As the noodles cool in the tapenade, they absorb its flavors and some of the pasta water, leaving just enough behind to emulsify the olive oil, so every bow tie stays glossy.

ingredients.raw: 1 garlic clove, finely grated or minced
½ teaspoon fresh thyme leaves or dried herbes de Provence
ingredients.item: fresh thyme leaves or dried herbes de provence

ingredients.raw: 1 pound short pasta, such as farfalle
½ pound green beans, halved crosswise
⅓ to ½ cup shaved ricotta salata, optional

steps.text: Bring a large pot of heavily salted water to boil.

Make the tapenade: Place the olives, garlic, thyme, fennel seeds, lemon zest and red wine vinegar in the bowl of a food processor. Blitz until the olives are broken down, but not into a paste. Add the olive oil and pulse once to combine. Scrape into a large bowl and set aside.

Prepare the pasta: Boil it for 4 minutes before adding the green beans, then continue to cook until the pasta is slightly shy of al dente and a little too firm to eat (the timing will range depending on the brand you’re using). Reserve 3 cups of pasta cooking water, then drain the pasta and green beans. Tip the pasta and beans into the bowl with the tapenade, add 2 cups of the pasta water, and toss to combine.
Stir the pasta from time to time as it cools to room temperature, about 30 minutes. Taste it. If it starts to look a little dry, add another splash of pasta water, or vinegar if it needs more acid.
Tear in the basil leaves, sprinkle over the ricotta salata (if using) and top with freshly ground black pepper just before serving, ideally at room temperature.

ingredients.raw: 1 to 2 tablespoons tarragon vinegar (or more to taste)
½ to ¾ cup extra-virgin olive oil
Coarse salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
ingredients.item: coarse salt and freshly ground pepper to taste

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until they are cooked. Meanwhile, make the mayonnaise.
Beat the egg yolks in a bowl with a whisk until they are thick and sticky. Add the vinegar and mustard and beat some more.

Gradually add a few drops of safflower oil and whisk them in. Continue adding safflower and olive oils, increasing the amount as you go, until you have a smooth emulsion. (If you add the oil too quickly and the mayonnaise curdles, add another egg yolk.) Season with salt and pepper.

Drain the potatoes and cut them in slices or quarters. Place them in a large serving bowl and coat with the mayonnaise. Add the herbs and onion and toss gently, taking care not to break the potatoes. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve at room temperature (do not refrigerate unless the weather is very hot and the salad has to be made way ahead of serving time).

ingredients.raw: 1 sprig fresh dill to yield 1 tablespoon chopped
ingredients.item: fresh dill to yield 1 tablespoon chopped

ingredients.raw: 1 sprig fresh parsley to yield 1 tablespoon chopped
ingredients.item: fresh parsley to yield 1 tablespoon chopped

steps.text: Scrub potatoes, but do not peel. Bring to a boil in water to cover and cook until they are tender but firm, 10 to 20 minutes, depending on size.

Meanwhile, wash, dry and chop the dill and parsley; rinse capers, and chop. In bowl large enough to hold the potatoes, mix the dill, parsley and capers with the sour cream, yogurt, vinegar and cayenne pepper.
When potatoes are cooked, drain and cut into quarters and mix with the dressing. Season with salt and pepper, and serve.

name: Tatsoi and Sweet-Corn Salad With Peach-Nectar Dressing
author: Molly O’Neill

ingredients.raw: 8 cups tatsoi greens, or other tender mild greens
Freshly squeezed lemon juice to taste
ingredients.item: freshly squeezed lemon juice to taste

steps.text: In a skillet set over medium heat, heat the oil. Add the peaches and cook, stirring occasionally, until very soft, about 20 minutes. Set aside to cool.

Meanwhile, bring an inch of salted water to a boil in a large pot. Add the corn and steam 5 minutes. Drain the corn and allow to cool. Using a knife, scrape the kernels off the cobs and place the kernels in a large bowl.
Just before serving, add the tatsoi, peaches and salt, and toss well. Season to taste with lemon juice, toss again and serve.
